Description.TranslatedText: Age grouping variable derived based on AGE. Subjects with AGE <65 assigned '<65 YEARS'; subjects with AGE >=65 assigned '>=65 YEARS'.
Numeric age group variable derived from AGEGR1 categories.
Treatment start date derived by converting DM.RFXSTDTC ISO8601 character date into SAS numeric date.
Treatment end date derived by converting DM.RFXENDTC ISO8601 character date into SAS numeric date.
Treatment duration in days calculated using treatment start and end dates.
Treatment duration in months calculated using INTCK month interval between TRTSDT and TRTEDT.
Treatment duration in years calculated using INTCK year interval between TRTSDT and TRTEDT.
informed consent date derived by converting RFICDTC ISO8601 character date into SAS numeric date.
Death date derived by converting DTHDTC ISO8601 character date into SAS numeric date when complete date was available.
Death flag assigned as 'Y' when death date is non-missing.
Numeric code assigned based on death cause category.
Enrollment date derived from DS domain disposition records.
Randomization date derived from DS domain disposition records.
End of study date derived from disposition records associated with study discontinuation.
End of study status assigned based on discontinuation information.
Randomization flag assigned as 'Y' for randomized subjects.
Safety population flag assigned as 'Y' for subjects with non-missing treatment start date.
Intent-to-treat population flag assigned based on randomization status.
Full analysis set flag assigned for randomized subjects with treatment exposure.
Enrollment flag assigned for subjects with non-missing enrollment date.
Baseline BMI calculated using baseline height and weight measurements.
Baseline BMI grouping variable derived using BMI categories.

Analysis start date derived from CMSTDTC using partial date imputation rules. Complete dates were converted directly; missing dates imputed using TRTSDT; partial month dates imputed to first day of month or TRTSDT when treatment month/year matched; year-only dates imputed to January 1.

Analysis start date imputation flag assigned based on level of date imputation. 'Y' assigned for completely missing date, 'D' assigned for partial month imputation, and 'M' assigned for year-only imputation.

Analysis end date derived from CMENDTC using partial date imputation rules. Missing end dates imputed using TRTEDT or ASTDT when TRTEDT occurred before ASTDT. Partial dates imputed using first day of month or year.

Analysis end date imputation flag assigned based on level of date imputation. 'Y' assigned for completely missing date, 'D' assigned for partial month imputation, and 'M' assigned for year-only imputation.
Analysis start relative day calculated relative to TRTSDT. Positive study days assigned using SDTM convention with Day 1 corresponding to TRTSDT.
Analysis end relative day calculated relative to TRTSDT using SDTM relative day convention.
Pre-treatment flag assigned as 'Y' for concomitant medications ending before treatment start date.
On-treatment flag assigned as 'Y' for medications overlapping treatment period based on ASTDT, AENDT, TRTSDT, and TRTEDT.
Actual treatment variable derived from ADSL TRT01A.
Numeric actual treatment variable derived from ADSL TRT01AN.

Analysis start date derived from AESTDTC using partial date imputation rules. Complete dates converted directly; missing dates imputed using TRTSDT; partial month dates imputed to first day of month or TRTSDT when treatment month/year matched; year-only dates imputed to January 1.

Analysis start date imputation flag assigned based on level of date imputation. 'Y' assigned for completely missing date, 'D' assigned for day imputation, and 'M' assigned for month and day imputation.

Analysis end date derived from AEENDTC using partial date imputation rules. Missing end dates imputed using TRTEDT or ASTDT when TRTEDT occurred before ASTDT. Partial dates imputed using first day of month or year.
Analysis end date imputation flag assigned based on level of date imputation. 'Y' assigned for completely missing date, 'D' assigned for day imputation, and 'M' assigned for month and day imputation.
Analysis start relative day calculated relative to TRTSDT using SDTM relative day convention.
Analysis end relative day calculated relative to TRTSDT using SDTM relative day convention.
Analysis duration calculated as difference between analysis end date and analysis start date plus one day.
Treatment emergent analysis flag assigned as 'Y' for adverse events with ASTDT greater than or equal to TRTSDT
Pre-treatment flag assigned as 'Y' for adverse events with ASTDT before TRTSDT.
Primary analysis flag assigned as 'Y' for treatment emergent adverse events in the safety population.
Analysis toxicity grade derived by converting AETOXGR character value into numeric format using INPUT function.
Parameter label derived by concatenating LBTEST and LBSTRESU in the format "LBTEST (Unit)".
Numeric parameter identifier assigned based on LBTESTCD values to maintain parameter ordering for analysis reporting.
Analysis date derived by converting SDTM LBDTC character date into numeric SAS date format using YYMMDD10. informat.
Baseline record flag assigned as 'Y' for the last non-missing assessment on or before TRTSDT within each subject and parameter.
Baseline analysis value derived from AVAL for records flagged as baseline using ABLFL='Y'.
Baseline character analysis value derived from AVALC for records flagged as baseline using ABLFL='Y'.
Baseline reference range indicator derived from LBNRIND for baseline records flagged with ABLFL='Y'.
Change from baseline calculated as AVAL minus BASE when both values are non-missing.
Percent change from baseline calculated as ((AVAL-BASE)/BASE)*100 and rounded to two decimal places when BASE is non-zero.
Primary analysis record flag assigned as 'Y' for post-treatment non-missing analysis records excluding baseline, screening, imaging, and lab retest visits.
